verdict.rationale: The Cloud Console is documented as the place to manage projects, API keys, usage, billing and team access. That implies keys can be organized per project, but nothing says keys can be restricted by permission, model, endpoint or spend. missing for 10: explicit per-key permission scopes or least-privilege roles, per-key model/endpoint/rate or budget restrictions, documentation of project-scoped key isolation, independent or hands-on corroboration.
